correctness.rationale: For a rank-one cross-block H, any free-class vector orthogonal to its restricted coupling is annihilated by H, trap and every active dephaser, so Q rho Q is constant. If positive sigma is stationary, trace loss forces sigma_ww=0; evaluating <ker sigma,L(sigma) ker sigma> forces every P_j to preserve Ran sigma, and off-support blocks force H invariance. A dephased site cannot lie in Ran sigma because H|j> (B) or H^2|j> (A) has nonzero w component. Spectral invariance excludes the two bright H eigenvectors; thus stationary positive states lie in Q. Cesàro and positivity eliminate the complementary block, yielding finite-dimensional exponential convergence; free-class ranks give (r-1)_++(s-1)_+, sharp dephaser budget a+b-3 and (a-1)b placements. Independently built full complex Lindbladians verify zero-multiplicity rank(Q)^2 and strict negativity of the other spectral real parts for five nontrivial instances; finite checks do not prove generality.
